legal_name: SEEMSAN PUMPS AND EQUIPMENTS PRIVATE LIMITED (as spelled on the company's own website footer: 'Seemsan Pumps and Equipments Pvt. Ltd.'; exact MCA-registered spelling NOT verified)
note: Registry data NOT obtained - all fields null rather than guessed. What was actually verified: (1) The company's own website seemsanpumps.com (fetched successfully) presents 'Seemsan Pumps and Equipments Pvt. Ltd.' as a manufacturer of chemical process pumps in PP/PVDF/PTFE/PFA-lined and stainless/super-alloy, with contact seemsanmum@gmail.com and +91-9223477016 - the 'mum' handle and the 922 prefix are consistent with Mumbai/Maharashtra, matching the claimed state, but this is a website claim, not a registry record. (2) Role 'manufacturer' is based on the company's self-description only ('leading manufacturer'); no MCA/NIC activity code was retrieved to confirm manufacturing vs trading. (3) NOT verified: CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, MCA status (active/struck off), registered office. Attempts: DuckDuckGo search tool returned connection refused (backend down); zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403; instafinancials.com and falconebiz.com returned JavaScript-only shells with no company data; tofler.in returned 404 for the guessed CIN; indiamart.com returned HTTP 429; Google returned a redirect page; Bing returned irrelevant results for both queries. The CIN U29299PN1997PTC010987 used in one URL was a guess and is NOT confirmed - do not treat it as real. (4) Revenue FY25/FY26: null - no audited accounts or MCA filings were accessible; no figure invented. (5) No rejection basis found: nothing indicates non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy, but equally nothing confirms the entity is active - MCA status must be re-checked on mca.gov.in before onboarding. (6) Declared HS 841391 (parts of pumps) is broadly consistent with the pump-manufacturing profile, but HS is not a rejection criterion per project rules and was not used as one. (7) Per project rules, no customs, court or catalogue research was performed in this role.
